title: rangeSlider could really do with a format for the start, middle and end figures
body:
Exactly that, would be good if rangeSlider would have a format option for not just tooltips but also the other values that are shown on it.

An example is using epoch date stamps with the range slider, getting out a step of 1,113,782,400.

comments.body:
We are using nouislider, can you check if this works: https://refreshless.com/nouislider/pips/#section-steps?

Thanks
It may just be that those options are from a recent version of nouislider that we do not support. Which option specifically is not working? pips.mode and density should be ok no?

Not from what I can see.

I just changed density to 5 and it did not work, kept them at 3
Oh wait, looking at wrong element, though worse, it breaks the actual element
AWESOME! Thanks for putting the answer back here.
